summary: NASA’s MODIS and VIIRS satellites track active fires globally, yet differing resolutions, timing, and sensor traits cause duplicate detections and skewed trends when naively merged. EARTH SYNC transforms raw NASA FIRMS data into a unified fire intelligence platform. Through a transparent Collect → Clean → Harmonize → Validate pipeline, it runs duplicate suppression, spatiotemporal alignment, and sensor calibration while exposing confidence, data freshness, and uncertainty. Alongside an Interactive Hotspot Map, our Burning Activity Calendar and Historical Anomaly Engine analyze multi-year baselines to pinpoint critical fire periods and flag unusual surges. With raw-vs-harmonized comparisons and CSV/GeoJSON exports, EARTH SYNC equips responders, land managers, and scientists for rapid action.
